name: List All Users
description: Returns all users that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: All GET requests must include a filter for [LastUpdatedAtFrom]. Filters users by the date their details were last updated, returning only users updated at or after this date-time.

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filters users by the unique identifier of a property.

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Number of results per page. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].UserRole
responseFields.description: The system role assigned to the user that dictates most permissions

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the user's details were last updated

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
